scope: One complete chronological conversation, baseline/exact only, one cold attempt per arm followed by strict replays; not pooled with128-turn primary.
timing_scope: Model already loaded; fresh response caches and prefix reset per cold arm. Download/server startup/READY/encoder warmup excluded, real inference and fast cache overhead included.
independent_arm_continuation: If baseline has an ordinary generation/execution failure before exact is attempted, preserve the original failed suite cell and execute its unchanged existing benchmark.py command with modes=optimized,warm only, once, in the same output/configuration with a fresh optimized cache. Record continuation separately; never retry baseline. If exact was already attempted, no further cold attempt. Source/config/replay integrity failures stop all work. Completed cold arms receive strict zero-HTTP replay where possible.
integrity_supervision: External scripts/watch_suite_integrity.py checks frozen source hashes and failure JSON error fields (including nested llm_diagnostic errors) every1second. It never scans generated response bodies. Baseline response ambiguity, identity/source errors and any replay failure require global stop; only the verified own runner/descendants may be terminated. Ordinary policy JSON/domain failures retain original once-only continuation rules.
